fact: The Data Protection Office has been operational since 16 February 2009 and enforces the Data Protection Act 2017; the report is signed by Data Protection Commissioner Drudeisha Madhub, who describes herself as the data protection regulator.

The Data Protection Office reports for January to December 2024: 179 new complaints (158 on CCTV), 39 complaints closed, 105 personal data breaches notified, 112 cross-border transfers authorised and 12 rejected under section 36, 10 impact assessments received, and four compliance inspections.

L'Express reports that Drudeisha Madhub, speaking as Data Protection Commissioner, and the Data Protection Office co-led the launch of the National Data Strategy 2025-2029 with the ministry on 28 January 2026, and that the Office signed an MoU with the Police and CERTMU.
Acclime reports that the Data Protection Office of Mauritius issued updated guidance in September 2026 requiring registration with the Data Protection Commissioner.

The Data Protection Office of Mauritius issued guidance in September 2026 to Management Companies on registering as controllers and processors with the Commissioner under the Data Protection Act 2017.
